summary: Recent improvements in the testing framework of Firefox focus on enhancing the reliability and accuracy of media handling, particularly around audio and video playback. A significant change keeps the system clock stable while the audio stream catches up after a user seeks (skips) within a video, ensuring a smoother playback experience. Additionally, several tests were added to verify the functionality and performance of key components, including the handling of HEVC video (a format known for high-quality compression) during seeking, and checks for potential crashes in media shutdown scenarios. These enhancements are essential for maintaining a robust browser environment, especially as video content continues to dominate online experiences. **Overall, these updates aim to improve video playback reliability and performance, ensuring a better user experience.**
